purpose: Base capability measurement at 32B for slm-learning ladder extension. Per slm-learning-210, the operator pushed back on capping at 7B (we are building novel work). This rung measures unmodified Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct on HE/MBPP/gad_tools to establish the upper anchor of the open Qwen 2.5 coder line before considering 80B-A3B.
fire_command_template: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 modal run modal_app/eval_adapter.py::main --adapter-id BASE --base-model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --benchmark {benchmark} --limit 164 --gpu A100 --persist-run-id eval-base-qwen-32b-coder-2026-05-09
fallback_quant: INT4 (~24GB) fits A10G but introduces quality skew; if A100-80GB blocked, prefer H100 over INT4 for comparison cleanliness. INT4 is a last resort and MUST be footnoted in the comparator row.

pass_criteria.knee_candidate: HE >= 0.890 AND MBPP >= 0.860 (>= 7B Stein +4pp on both axes)
pass_criteria.promote_to_training_target: knee_candidate AND wall-clock inference latency under 5s/task on A100 chat-mode
pass_criteria.reject_rung: HE delta vs 14B base < +2pp (no clear lift over 14B = 32B is not worth its cost)

preflight_notes: DO NOT FIRE without Dr. Stein authorization. 32B BF16 requires A100-80GB; verify Modal A100-80GB availability before launch. 32B BF16 weights are ~64GB on disk; confirm slm-models volume free space.
